purpose: Test whether the joint trajectory degradation is primarily caused by trajectory-task loss/gradient underweighting.

gradient_diagnostic.scope: shared target, scene, social, proposal, gate, and fusion parameters; task-specific output heads excluded
gradient_diagnostic.sampling: one fixed balanced 512-sample training subset and one fixed ambiguous subset per seed, measured after each epoch
gradient_diagnostic.side_effects: autograd.grad only; no optimizer update; Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG states restored

selection_note: Best checkpoint per run follows the existing validation composite score; compare lambda conditions by validation ADE/AUC before drawing confirmatory conclusions. Test metrics are reported for held-out descriptive comparison.
